description: Compact feed of currently active NasDecode Market Watch catalysts.

activeEvents.companyMarket: Foxconn / Hon Hai / NVDA / AAPL / AI servers
activeEvents.headline: Foxconn Q3 net profit rises 34% above consensus; projects high-double-digit AI rack shipment growth in 2027
activeEvents.direction: Positive demand signal, subject to financing and delivery risk
activeEvents.whyItMatters: Nvidia's major AI server assembler reported T$77.5B Q3 net profit versus T$69.6B consensus and forecast high-double-digit 2027 AI rack shipment growth. This is direct downstream supply-chain evidence of continued AI server buildout despite AI capex concerns; it does not quantify incremental GPU orders.

activeEvents.companyMarket: NVDA / US Congress / China AI chip export controls
activeEvents.headline: US senators Warren and Coons demand preservation of Nvidia China export records and briefing on alleged intelligence risks
activeEvents.whyItMatters: A formal congressional document-preservation request and briefing demand escalates the existing Nvidia leadership and export-control controversy into direct oversight of executive-branch export licensing and counterintelligence decisions. The request is not a finding of wrongdoing or an enacted restriction.

activeEvents.companyMarket: Siemens Energy / AI data-center power / NVDA / Nasdaq
activeEvents.headline: Siemens Energy reports €15B data-center power orders and raises FY2027 margin outlook to 14–16%, confirming AI electricity infrastructure demand
activeEvents.whyItMatters: Siemens Energy disclosed roughly €15 billion in data-center-related turbine and grid orders, 9.1% of its record €164 billion backlog, and expects its profit margin to increase to 14–16% in FY2027 from 12.4% in FY2026. This is independently reported order-book evidence of AI data-center electricity infrastructure demand and the power-supply bottleneck relevant to AI compute deployment. It is not evidence that GPU orders increased by the same amount.
